calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM dim_product WHERE LOWER(category) LIKE '%clean%' AND is_current = TRUE
SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 5

SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 107
  AND dp.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as line_count, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN fsl.quantity ELSE 0 END) as staff_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE OR fsl.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL THEN fsl.quantity ELSE 0 END) as regular_units
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 107
  AND dp.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'

SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as returned_units
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON frl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 107
  AND dp.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND frl.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'

SELECT 
  ds.store_name,
  'Period 5' as fiscal_period_label,
  'FY2026/27' as fiscal_year,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 107
  AND dp.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ds.store_name
